His story

Why he lights up homes

“When I was young I witnessed our neighbour’s house catch fire and burn to ashes. A single mother of four had gone out in the evening to buy food and supplies, leaving a two-year-old at home. The child played near the kerosene lamp, and the fire took his life. From then I decided that when I grew up I would study hard and use my knowledge to fight the use of kerosene lamps.

“Thousands of villages in the heart of rural Africa still use kerosene lamps. Lighting up the world and bringing a smile and hope to people who never thought they would see light at night is considered a miracle by the locals, and it starts with a single home.”

Bugoye, Kasese

A village that now shines

In Kyabarungira, Bugoye Sub County, Busongora County, Kasese District, a mountain village far from the grid lived for decades in darkness. Families relied on kerosene lamps for light and firewood for cooking. That strained household budgets and led to breathing problems, eyesight disorders and deforestation. Children had little time to read, which led to failure and dropping out of school, and mothers delivering at night had too little light.

Working with Solar Grandma’s initiative and the Isaka Kaihura Foundation, Emmanuel Electricals and Solar Power has brought standalone solar systems to close to 30 homes in Bugoye. The people of Kasese call it ERIAKA, which means “we are shining.”

Qualifications

Trained and experienced

  • National Certificate in Electrical Systems and Maintenance
  • Close to five years of experience
  • Solar system design, installation and maintenance
Impact

Work that speaks for itself

  • Worked with partners to equip health centres in Fort Portal with solar power for continuous medical care
  • Trained residents of Kabende, alongside SOS Children’s Village, in solar installation and maintenance

A committed advocate for renewable energy, Emmanuel combines technical skill with a genuine desire to create a brighter, more sustainable world.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about our services and how we work. Still unsure? Message us on WhatsApp.

What services do you offer?

Solar installation, inverters and batteries, wiring and distribution boards, decorative lighting, solar street and flood lights, repairs and maintenance, and an electrical supplies shop.

Where do you work?

We work across Uganda. Our shop is on Rukidi III St in Fort Portal, and our team travels to jobs in other towns and villages. Message us your location and we will confirm.

How do I get a quote?

Send photos and a short description on WhatsApp or call us. We will tell you what is needed and give a clear quote before any work begins.

Can I just buy parts without an installation?

Yes. Visit our shop for electrical components, tools and more.

Do you do repairs as well as new installations?

Yes. We handle fault finding, repairs and regular maintenance for homes and businesses.

How can I see your past work?

Browse the photos and videos on this page or follow us on Instagram or Facebook.
